# Ioncube Loader

This mod adds Ioncube loader to SWAG/nginx, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `swag` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:swag-ioncube
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:swag-ioncube|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/swag-ioncube/
